CHROMIUM: drm/img-rogue: generate WARNING on PVR_K Call OSWarnOn() instead of OSDumpStack() when making a Debug Dump. The DDK Debug Dump contains information useful for diagnosing problems. It is produced automatically in a number of different scenarios. It usually contains a stack dump. By using OSWarnOn() - WARN_ON() - the stack dump is presented in a standard way and can be used to trigger the ChromeOS crash reporter. autotest: Add chrome-informational test suite Move desktopui_MusLogin and desktopui_MashLogin to the new suite. These tests need to run on hardware, but are for features in Chrome that are still under development behind flags. We don't want to block Chrome PFQ uprev if they fail, just inform the gardener. This gives us an alternative to bvt-perbuild that we can run continuously against ToT chrome to provide narrower chrome revision ranges for regressions. Remove hacky board-specific control files for these tests. They were an attempt to put the tests in bvt-cq for just a couple of boards, but if we introduce a flaky regression in these features we don't want to block the CQ. BUG=chromium:737240 TEST=presubmits Change-Id: I97af6d24793c2fed529b3cc799960c07506228ac Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/550863 Commit-Ready: Ilja H.
